Indian-origin candidates made their presence felt in the 2026 US midterm elections. Pia Dandiya won Florida's 22nd Congressional District, Suhas Subramanyam secured re-election in Virginia, and Aruna Miller retained her position in Maryland. Meanwhile, Vivek Ramaswamy trailed in Ohio's governor race in early results. Here's a look at the key Indian-American candidates and their electoral fortunes.
